direct_reasons: Napalm T2 lifesteal 15%→20% directly feeds the Dashfernus sustain loop that already posts his better win rate.
Concussive Combustion T3 now adds +0.4 spirit scaling, a real damage bump for the spirit build rather than a cosmetic talent.
indirect_reasons: Toxic Bullets anti-heal 35%→40% and Decay -50%→-55% strengthen the anti-heal package he already buys, and the patch's anti-heal theme punishes the sustain fronts his burn out-ranges.

Spirit Lifesteal 13%→15% and Bullet Lifesteal buffs land on his sustain slots exactly as regen items (Radiant Regeneration, Healing Booster) are gutted — his build is on the winning side of the sustain shift.
Spiritual Overflow's +2 spirit is a token recovery; he dropped it post-09-16 and this does not restore it.
build_changes: Keep Toxic Bullets and Spirit Lifesteal as fixed slots — both were buffed this patch.
Take Napalm T2 earlier in the Dashfernus line; the 20% lifesteal is now a genuine lane-sustain talent.
heroes.one_liner: Burn carry quietly gained: anti-heal and lifesteal both moved his way.

indirect_reasons: Haunt bounty and growth +10% on the camps he clears fastest is the single largest income lever in the patch, and his AoE clear converts it better than anyone.
Haunt HP and damage +10% is the offset — but Spirit Lifesteal 13%→15% and Decay -50%→-55% both buff his exact core slots, so he absorbs the harder camps better than most clearers.

The comeback package (non-hero gold 26%→30%, faster Haunted Souls when behind, tick souls to the two poorest) directly reverses the KB's 'a behind Seven cannot brawl back' cap — he now has a farm route from behind.
build_changes: Spirit Lifesteal is now a stronger second-item commitment against the tougher camps.
Decay is a better slot into the sustain comps the anti-heal patch encourages.
heroes.one_liner: Richer camps plus a real comeback route — the farm carry got both ends fixed.

indirect_reasons: High-Velocity Rounds base bullet velocity 60%→45% trims her opening max-range poke — the exact window her gun build buys it for.
Move slow to air-drag ratio 0.35→0.5 taxes her harder whenever she is slowed mid-flight, compounding the existing flyer tax.
Steam Vents losing invisibility removes a free-approach tool from the roamers that dive her, which partly offsets the above.
build_changes: Upgrade off base High-Velocity Rounds faster to recover velocity rather than sitting on the T2.
heroes.one_liner: Slower bullets and heavier air drag on a 48.7% flyer — the A was already generous.

direct_reasons: Essence Bomb spirit scaling 1.22→1.35 is a genuine buff to the Spirit Soul-Exchange variant's burst.
indirect_reasons: Radiant Regeneration is gutted — spirit-damage regen 0.35→0.25, heal-on-cast 65→40, boon scaling 1.7→1.4, and the heal now only fires in combat — on an item she buys in ~98% of games.
Healing Booster loses its Extra Regen component and +3 flat regen, gutting the second leg of her regen shell.
Decay -50%→-55% and Healbane stacking help her anti-heal slot, but they cut against her own sustain identity as much as they help her kill other fronts.
build_changes: Shift sustain weight from Radiant Regeneration/Healing Booster toward Spirit Lifesteal (13%→15%) and Bullet Lifesteal.
The Spirit Soul-Exchange variant now has the better damage line (Essence Bomb 1.35) but the weaker sustain line — commit to burst, not grind.
heroes.one_liner: Her regen shell took its fourth and biggest hit; the bomb buff does not cover it.

direct_reasons: Base gun damage +5% and Siphon Life T3 +18→+22 DPS both nudge his brawl damage without changing his role.
The Shoulder Charge fix removes the extra hold he got from not hitting a wall — a small real loss to his engage.
indirect_reasons: Hunter's Aura now requires line of sight, removing the through-wall shred that made his melee-brawler core a stat-check in clumped fights — his single biggest item hit.
Healing Snacks 10%→14% max HP and the new Heavy-Melee Cauldrons (Candy/Sugar Rush) reward exactly the frontline kit that already owns the crate route.
Decay -50%→-55% buffs his anti-heal answer to enemy fronts; Point Blank's slow 2s→2.5s is a small new stick option.
build_changes: Hunter's Aura is now a fight-only item — stop valuing it as a corridor/objective shred and consider a competing slot.
Point Blank is a live option for holding targets in melee range.
heroes.one_liner: Frontline economy and Cauldrons help; Hunter's Aura losing through-wall shred hurts.

rows.label: Shoulder Charge
rows.text: No longer holds enemies in place

direct_reasons: Card Trick heal 60→45 cuts the self-sustain that keeps her alive through the dive she already loses to.
Project Mind cooldown 46s→50s and initial cast time 0.75s→1s make her escape/rotate tool slower on both ends.
indirect_reasons: Spirit Lifesteal 13%→15% is a small lift to her situational sustain-gun variant, but it does not offset three direct nerfs.
The patch's anti-heal theme (Decay, Toxic Bullets, Healbane stacking) further devalues the Card Trick heal she just lost.
build_changes: Lean harder into the pure-gun fire-rate line; the on-hit spirit package is already weakened and the heal is now worse.
heroes.one_liner: Heal cut and a slower escape on a hero already sliding — the floor is thinner.

direct_reasons: Mini Turret damage vs troopers 50%→65% speeds her lane push and camp-adjacent farm.
Mini Turret health per boon 9→10 makes turret stacks survive dive and camp chip slightly longer.
indirect_reasons: Haunt bounty +10% rewards turrets clearing grouped camps from cover, though the +10% camp damage chips the turrets themselves.
Breakables growth -10% trims the crate income her static setup does not contest anyway — a wash.
heroes.one_liner: Turrets farm and push a bit better; still a low-pick niche controller.

direct_reasons: Paradoxical Swap cooldown 110s→95s is a real uptime gain on her pick tool.
indirect_reasons: High-Velocity Rounds base velocity 60%→45% and Express Shot secondary fire -5% both hit her carbine-sniper core, trimming the max-range picks the swap buff is meant to set up.
Steam Vents losing invisibility removes the roamer approach the KB credits for her rising pick setups — a direct hit to her identity.
Echo Shard post-cast 0.5s→0.2s speeds her niche bomb combo, but usage data already had it outside her top 15.
build_changes: Upgrade off base High-Velocity Rounds sooner; the velocity cut bites the early lane-poke window hardest.
heroes.one_liner: Swap comes up more often, but her poke items and vent invis both got trimmed.

indirect_reasons: Mid-Boss pit is bigger with more cover and the Rejuvenator now drops as 3 spread crystals — more cover blunts Singularity setup and splitting for three crystals punishes the grouped-up comp he wants.
The comeback package lengthens games, which is mildly against a tempo initiator whose value is converting early hub fights.
No core item of his moved; Quantum Entanglement's AoE dispel is untouched.
heroes.one_liner: Nothing moved for him directly; the Mid-Boss rework is a small setup tax.

direct_reasons: Frozen Shelter T2 now also applies -20% enemy fire rate and T3 regen 65→75, both real buffs to the dome.
Base cooldown 185s→190s is offset by T1 -20s→-30s, so the talented dome is actually 5s faster.
indirect_reasons: Healing Booster losing its Extra Regen component and +3 flat regen guts the backbone of his sustain shell — the bigger hit than the dome buffs.
Radiant Regeneration's major trim also removes a sustain layer he stacks.
Healing Nova switching from boon scaling to 1.1 spirit scaling rewards his spirit-stacked build; Healing Snacks 10%→14% caps what dedicated healing he can sell.
build_changes: Rebuild the sustain layer around Spirit Lifesteal (13%→15%) and Healing Nova's spirit scaling instead of Healing Booster.
Frozen Shelter T2 is now worth taking earlier as an anti-carry tool.
heroes.one_liner: Dome got better, his regen shell got worse — roughly a wash on a 53.9% hero.

direct_reasons: Smoke Bomb T3 no longer dispels undispellable debuffs — a small trim to her escape/cleanse window.
indirect_reasons: Return Fire now reflects Fixation damage, handing tanks a targeted counter-item into her stacking DoT.
The patch's anti-heal and lifesteal shift does nothing for her weak T4 gun items, which the KB already flags as her scaling ceiling.
build_changes: Expect Return Fire on enemy fronts — do not rely on Fixation stacks alone to close kills into tanks.
heroes.one_liner: A counter-item now exists for Fixation; her ceiling is unchanged and still low.

indirect_reasons: Steam Vents reworked from invisibility to +150% stamina regen removes the free roam approach the KB credits for her pick routes.
Tunnel move speed +70%→+50% slows the rotations her lasso picks depend on.
The comeback package lengthens games and softens lane leads — directly against a tempo assassin sitting at 46.3% WR.
build_changes: Lean on the stamina hybrid line (Sprint Boots, Extra Stamina, Recharging Rush) now that vents give stamina rather than stealth.
heroes.one_liner: Her two roam tools — vent invis and fast tunnels — both got pulled back.
